description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Booz Allen Hamilton is seeking a Back End Developer to build user-focused software solutions in an agile environment. The role involves developing Java-based enterprise applications, designing and integrating back-end frameworks and APIs, analyzing architectural environments, and implementing system improvements.
Back-end software engineer building APIs and production systems, analyzing architecture, and implementing system improvements

Responsibilities:
• As a software engineer, you know that good software is more than just a nice-looking interface and data
• You need the right combination of clean code, APIs, analytics, and infrastructure to develop a user-focused solution
• We’re looking for a software engineer like you to develop efficient and effective software, from vision to production-ready systems in an exciting, agile environment
• As a software engineer at Booz Allen, you’ll use the latest architectural approaches and open-source frameworks and tools to deliver complete end-to-end solutions to your clients
• Using your software engineering expertise, you’ll analyze the environment to ensure that your team’s solutions consider the current architecture and operating environment, as well as future functionality and enhancements
• You’ll sharpen your skills as you master new tools and techniques while helping to identify and implement system improvements

Requirements:
• Experience using Java to build enterprise products and applications
• Experience with back-end frameworks such as Spring or Quarkus
• Experience with Git and GitLab CI/CD
• Experience working in a team environment
• Secret clearance
• HS diploma or GED
• Ability to obtain a Security+ Certification within 3 months of hire date

Preferred:
• Experience with AI or ML pipelines and processes
• Experience with Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) software patterns to ingest large and complex datasets
• Experience with containerized environments such as Docker and Kubernetes
• Experience working with geospatial tools and datasets
• Experience with scripting languages such as Python or Bash
• Experience building real-time data processing applications using streaming libraries such as Kafka Streams
• Experience with metadata management such as Data Catalogs or Advana and graph databases such as Neo4j
• Knowledge of analytic platforms such as Kafka or Spark
• TS/SCI clearance
• Bachelor's degree in an IT field
